decision: Implement offline local administrator password recovery only; defer TOTP and recovery codes.
authorization: Product owner selected: Nur lokale Admin-Recovery; TOTP später. Concrete proposal in local planning was reviewed before implementation.
constraints: No public recovery endpoint, universal password or new sign-in method.
Interactive hidden password input only; require existing private database and owner-only local storage, stopped-service and backup confirmation.
Preserve administrator identity, VPN settings, encrypted credentials, downloads, and encryption keys; atomically replace the selected password and revoke its sessions.
Recovery never creates a database or performs schema migration; record a secret-free audit event.
No live NAS account mutation or deployment is authorized by this decision.
TOTP remains a documented coverage gap; this decision does not waive applicable release security gates.
